variable_coverage.construction: Observed transaction-price change Δp_t; requires transaction prices p_t and the immediately preceding transaction price. The source does not bound the calendar time to that previous trade.
Signed order flow q_t = D_t × shares traded, with D=+1 for buys and −1 for sells classified using Lee–Ready. Trade size and quote-assisted order sign are required.
Order-sign change D_t−D_(t−1), using Lee–Ready signs; its previous-transaction input has no source-bounded calendar interval.

GHLAMBDA is the quarterly average of retained stock-month λ estimates after the 10% significance screen; retained λ is multiplied by 1,000 for presentation. The equation (2) estimator/inference rule is not specified.

POST=1 for quarters 1–8 after the earliest qualifying revelation (amendment, following filing reflecting agreed changes, or public release of letters); POST=0 for the eight quarters before the first letter; the intervening case period is omitted.
Quarterly average of daily share turnover; a candidate construction is daily CRSP volume divided by shares outstanding, but the denominator/unit convention is not stated.
Standard deviation of daily stock returns within the quarter; CRSP RET/RETX and return adjustment convention are not specified by the paper.
Natural log of market value of equity at quarter end; candidate CRSP construction is abs(PRC)×SHROUT, but the scale/unit inside the log is not stated.
Quarter-end market value of equity divided by quarter-end book equity. CRSP market value and Compustat quarterly equity are candidate inputs; the exact book-equity items/adjustments are unspecified.

Proportion of firm shares held by institutions at quarter end; requires manager holdings, a shares-outstanding denominator and CUSIP/PERMNO matching. Aggregation/denominator/product details are not given.
Number of analysts making earnings forecasts during the quarter from I/B/E/S records; exact fiscal-period and analyst deduplication/count window are unspecified.

design_coverage.reason: The paper reports no weight field or weight construction for this column; whether the regression is unweighted is not stated and is listed as a blocking specification issue.
Equation (1) is shown as a regression with firm/year effects, but the underlying estimator and intercept treatment are not named.

implementation_issues.description: The equation (1) estimator is unnamed; the paper also does not specify a standalone intercept or weighting rule. The selected column has firm/year FE and firm-clustered standard errors, but the firm key used for FE/clustering is not identified.

The stock-month equation (2) estimator, intercept/inference procedure and exact test underlying the 10% lambda significance screen are not stated. The fit count is also unreported, so GHLAMBDA’s screening construction cannot be matched exactly.

The post window requires the earliest case-specific qualifying event and a case resolution date. SEC letters, amendments and subsequent filings must be read and linked case by case; the paper gives no event-date list and no bounded post-event endpoint.
The paper does not define the exact institutional-ownership aggregation/denominator or analyst-following count window and I/B/E/S forecast-deduplication rule. These affect required controls.

variable_coverage.construction: The source identifies a market-model BETA estimated over the year before each earnings announcement, but does not identify the underlying observed return series or market regressor. Current-quarter EPS used as the regression outcome over the past ten years.
Same-fiscal-quarter prior-year EPS predictor (t−4 quarters) in the ten-year persistence regression; adds one year of raw EPS history before the fit window.
CAR, the three-day (-1,+1) cumulative abnormal return around each quarterly earnings announcement; source says CRSP firm return minus CRSP value-weighted market return.

SUE, unexpected earnings based on the median analyst forecasts issued within 90 days before the quarterly earnings announcement and deflated by quarter-end share price; exact numerator, forecast selection and measure are not specified.
POST indicator for the eight quarters after the earliest qualifying revelation and zero for the eight quarters before the first comment letter, omitting the intervening case period.
POST × SUE interaction, constructed from the case-level POST indicator and SUE.
NONLINEAR = SUE × |SUE|.
PERSIST, the slope from the supporting regression of current-quarter EPS on same-quarter prior-year EPS over the past ten years; fit unit/estimator/intercept are unspecified.
PREDICT, square root of the error variance from the supporting EPS persistence regression.
BETA, the supporting market-model regression coefficient from the year before the earnings announcement; return series/proxy/frequency/fit unit are unspecified.
Quarter-end market value of equity divided by quarter-end book value of equity; exact Compustat equity construction is unspecified.
Natural log of market value of equity; the ERC-specific valuation date and scale are not specified.
Indicator for negative quarterly earnings. The exact earnings item, adjustment and zero/missing coding are unspecified.
Indicator for an earnings announcement for the fourth quarter; fiscal versus calendar quarter coding is unspecified.
Indicator equal to one when the earnings surprise is zero or positive; depends on the unresolved SUE construction.
Interaction SUE × PERSIST. The second interaction factor is PERSIST; each source component retains its own temporal window in the audit.
Interaction SUE × PREDICT. The second interaction factor is PREDICT; each source component retains its own temporal window in the audit.
Interaction SUE × BETA. The second interaction factor is BETA; each source component retains its own temporal window in the audit.
Interaction SUE × MTB. The second interaction factor is MTB; each source component retains its own temporal window in the audit.
Interaction SUE × SIZE. The second interaction factor is SIZE; each source component retains its own temporal window in the audit.
Interaction SUE × LOSS. The second interaction factor is LOSS; each source component retains its own temporal window in the audit.

design_coverage.reason: The paper does not report a weight field or weight construction for the selected full-model column; whether the regression is unweighted remains a specification gap.
Equation (1) and the table identify the regressor set, fixed effects and clustered inference, but not the underlying estimator/intercept treatment.

implementation_issues.description: The Table 4 column (2) regression estimator is not named, and intercept/weighting treatment is not reported for this full model. The paper reports firm/year FE and firm-clustered SEs but does not identify the firm key used for those dimensions.

SUE is not expressed as an exact numerator formula; the forecast product/adjustment, 90-day analyst-record selection, revision handling, analyst deduplication and forecast vintage are not specified. Quarter-end share-price adjustment and actual EPS alignment also remain open.

The ten-year EPS persistence regression does not specify fitting unit, estimator, intercept, missing-quarter rule or exact actual-EPS series. Its prior-year same-quarter predictor requires an additional 12 months of raw history beyond the ten-year fit window.

BETA’s one-year market model does not identify dependent returns, market return proxy, return frequency, fit unit, intercept or estimator. r_beta_spec keeps the unspecified raw market-model inputs explicit.
The ERC SIZE definition omits its valuation date and unit; quarter end is stated for the separate GHLAMBDA SIZE control only and cannot be carried over silently.
LOSS’s earnings item/zero coding and Q4’s fiscal-versus-calendar quarter rule are not identified; MEETBEAT follows the unresolved SUE construction.

The post window requires case-specific resolution and the first of amendment, a later filing reflecting agreed changes, or public release of letters. Exact case dates and content decisions are not supplied.
